name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maan-Dhan Yojana (PM-KMY): Farmer Pension
summary: A contributory old-age pension for small and marginal farmers: you pay a small monthly amount, the government pays the same amount, and you get ₹3,000 a month from age 60.

benefits.headline: ₹3,000 per month pension after age 60
details: You contribute ₹55 to ₹200 a month depending on your age when you join (18 to 40), and the Central Government adds an equal amount.
Your spouse can join separately and also get ₹3,000 a month.
If you die after receiving pension, your spouse gets a family pension of 50% (₹1,500 a month).
Pension is managed by LIC; enrolment is free of charge.

summary: Small or marginal farmer with up to 2 hectares (about 4.94 acres) of cultivable land.
Aged between 18 and 40 years when you enrol.
Not already covered by the National Pension System (NPS), ESIC or EPFO, and not enrolled in PM-SYM or PM-LVM pension schemes.

verify: Other 'higher economic status' exclusions used in PM-KISAN (for example constitutional post holders and serving government employees) may also apply. Confirm at the enrolment centre.
Your name must appear in the land records on the date you enrol.

adjust.reason: Joining younger means a lower monthly contribution

documents.note: Used to auto-debit your monthly contribution.

documents.note: Must show cultivable land in your name.

documents.name: First monthly contribution (in cash at the centre)

steps: Visit your nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) with Aadhaar, bank details and land records. Enrolment is free of charge.
The operator verifies your details and registers you; you sign an auto-debit mandate for the monthly contribution.
Pay the first contribution in cash. You receive a Kisan Pension Account Number and a pension card.
Keep enough balance in your bank account on the monthly due date so your contribution is not missed.
offline: State nodal officer for PM-KISAN at your district Agriculture office

deadline.text: Enrolment stays open, but only up to age 40, so the sooner you join the lower your monthly contribution.
